name: anam
description: Build and manage Anam personas: real-time AI avatars that talk with people over video.

interface.longDescription:
Anam makes personas: real-time AI avatars that talk with people over video, for uses such as customer support, sales, reception, tutoring and interview practice. Connect your Anam account to build and manage them from ChatGPT.

With Anam you can:
- Create a persona from a short brief, with a recommended avatar, voice and language model, and get a link to talk to it.
- Browse the avatars, voices and language models your organization can use.
- Add knowledge from text or web pages so a persona can answer questions about your product.
- Create and manage share links.
- Make a custom avatar from a photo you have the rights to.
- Send a persona into a Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams call.
- Find past sessions by date, persona or what was said, read their transcripts, and improve a persona from what callers asked.
- Look up how to add a persona to a website or app, from Anam's documentation.

Who it's for: teams that build or run Anam personas, and developers adding them to their products.

Limitations: you need an Anam account. Each connection acts on one Anam organization that you choose when you sign in, and reaches only that organization. Read-only access still reads everything in it, including session transcripts and knowledge. Full access can also change and delete things and start billed work. Conversations with a persona happen in a browser or your own app, not inside ChatGPT. Only use images and voices you have the right to use, and don't recreate a real person without their consent.
capabilities: Add knowledge from text or web pages
defaultPrompt: Create a receptionist avatar for my dental clinic and give me a link to try it.
Find a friendly British English voice and avatar for a support agent.
Show my persona sessions from last week that mention pricing.

positive.prompt: Find a friendly female voice and an avatar for a receptionist.
positive.expected_behavior: Recommends an avatar and a voice from the account's catalog by name, with a short reason and a preview link.

positive.description: Create a persona with a share link
positive.prompt: Create a receptionist persona called Rosa and give me a link to talk to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the persona Rosa and returns a share link URL that opens the persona in a browser, where you can talk to it.

positive.prompt: Add this FAQ to a knowledge folder called Clinic FAQ and let Riley use it: We open 8am to 6pm, Monday to Friday. Parking is free behind the building.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm the upload, adds the FAQ as a document in the Clinic FAQ folder (creating the folder if it doesn't exist), and attaches the folder to Riley, the receptionist persona in the test organization.

Opens the Anam app full screen with the organization's personas and their avatars. Choosing one shows it with Talk, Change with ChatGPT and Open in Lab. Talk opens a share link in the browser. The app is also in the sidebar under Anam.

positive.description: Find sessions by what was said
positive.prompt: Show my sessions from the last 30 days that mention parking.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching sessions in the test organization with dates and short snippets, and says how many transcripts it checked.

negative.prompt: Upgrade my Anam plan and pay with my credit card.
Show me the sessions of a different company's Anam account.
Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: Anam doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. Usage of an existing Anam account is billed by Anam under that account's own plan.

publication.release_notes: Adds your own voice: when no stock voice fits, ChatGPT gives you a link to a Lab page where you record a short sample, upload an audio file or import a voice from your ElevenLabs account, then picks up the new voice for your persona. Your audio and any ElevenLabs key stay in Lab, not in the chat. New tools: anam_voice_add (makes the link; creates nothing until you act on the page) and anam_voice_add_status (read only). New skill: add-your-own-voice. The Anam app in ChatGPT's sidebar also gets Voices and Avatars tabs next to Personas: search them, play voice samples and avatar preview clips, and give one to a persona, with Undo. A persona's page now shows its voice and avatar, each with a link to change it.
